To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
price momentum outperforms earnings momentum and that the best performing momentum strategy at the country/ region level is the one that combines price momentum and enhanced earnings momentum.
price momentum strategies performed better than earnings momentum strategies, but that combining price momentum with enhanced earning momentum produced the best returns.

(i) Price momentum is a good predictor of future stock returns, (ii) Earnings momentum is a poor predictor of future stock return, (iii) Price and earnings momentum strategies complement each other when combined, (iv) The best combination of price and earnings momentum strategy depends on the market, and (v) Earnings forecasts made by equity analysts provide a useful means for enhancing price momentum strategies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to enhance momentum strategies by placing stocks in their momentum life cycle.
the identification and exploitation of the life cycle of momentum strategies in the context of European equity markets.
the development of momentum strategies for European stocks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

price momentum is the best momentum strategy for European stocks, but that earnings momentum can be used to enhance the performance of price momentum and that the earnings forecasts of the equity analysts provide an excellent means for placing a stock in its life cycle.

price momentum strategies are more likely to produce superior returns than earnings momentum strategies and that these strategies complement each other when combined but that the earnings momentum strategies should be enhanced using analyst forecasts.
the momentum life cycle for European stocks is a dynamic one in the sense that the performance of a stock depends on the stage it is in its life cycle and the momentum strategy employed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best strategy is to invest in price momentum stocks and to exit them when they enter the winning stage.
the equity analysts are good at identifying winning stocks but that they are not good at identifying losing stocks.
price momentum strategies are the best way to exploit the momentum effect in the European markets but that enhanced earnings momentum can be used to improve these strategies.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the momentum life cycle is an appropriate way to think of the momentum phenomenon and that it is possible to use the earnings forecasts made for a stock by the equity analysts to determine its current momentum status.
price and earnings momentum are not only complementary but that they can also be enhanced by incorporating information from other sources.
the equity analysts’ earnings forecasts are not a good predictor of the momentum life cycle and that the best strategy is to combine the two strategies in the manner described above.
